winner_decision.rule: highest mean plus Holm-significant superiority to every other method

protocol.name: Turbo Dash final blinded test
protocol.winner_rule: A single winner may be declared only if it has the highest seed-level mean finalScore and every pairwise comparison against it is significant after Holm correction in the prespecified post-hoc family. Otherwise report no unambiguous winner and the statistically inseparable top set.
protocol.blinding: Until all 3000 valid episodes are present, console and progress artifacts contain only counts, health, ETA and retries; no scores, ranks or method summaries are emitted.

selected_models.selection: the only frozen Research Protocol v1 deterministic baseline; no result-based choice
selected_models.validation_500_note: No pre-existing 500-second VALIDATION artifact exists; none was created during the freeze.
